items.name: Inland Revenue Department
items.description: Responsible for domestic tax administration, income tax, VAT, excise duties, taxpayer services, and tax compliance.
items.descriptionNepali: आन्तरिक कर प्रशासन, आयकर, मूल्य अभिवृद्धि कर, अन्तःशुल्क, करदाता सेवा तथा कर अनुपालनसम्बन्धी कार्य गर्ने विभाग।
items.keywords: ird tax vat income revenue taxpayer ird.gov.np

items.name: Department of Customs
items.description: Responsible for customs administration, import and export clearance, customs revenue collection, and trade facilitation.
items.descriptionNepali: भन्सार प्रशासन, आयात तथा निर्यात जाँचपास, भन्सार राजस्व सङ्कलन तथा व्यापार सहजीकरणसम्बन्धी कार्य गर्ने विभाग।
items.keywords: customs import export duty trade customs.gov.np

items.name: Department of Revenue Investigation
items.description: Responsible for investigation of revenue leakage, tax evasion, and related financial and economic offenses.
items.descriptionNepali: राजस्व चुहावट, कर छली तथा सम्बन्धित आर्थिक तथा वित्तीय अपराधको अनुसन्धान गर्ने विभाग।
items.keywords: revenue investigation tax evasion financial crime dri.gov.np

items.name: Department of Money Laundering Investigation
items.description: Responsible for investigation of money laundering and related financial offenses.
items.descriptionNepali: सम्पत्ति शुद्धीकरण तथा सम्बन्धित वित्तीय अपराधको अनुसन्धान गर्ने विभाग।
items.keywords: money laundering financial crime investigation dmlib.gov.np

items.name: Department of Transport Management
items.description: Responsible for transport administration, vehicle registration, driver licensing, and related road transport services.
items.descriptionNepali: यातायात प्रशासन, सवारी दर्ता, चालक अनुमतिपत्र तथा सडक यातायातसम्बन्धी सेवाको व्यवस्थापन गर्ने विभाग।
items.keywords: dotm transport vehicle driver license road dotm.gov.np

items.name: Department of Roads
items.description: Responsible for planning, development, maintenance, and management of the strategic road network.
items.descriptionNepali: रणनीतिक सडक सञ्जालको योजना, निर्माण, विकास, मर्मत तथा व्यवस्थापनसम्बन्धी कार्य गर्ने विभाग।
items.keywords: roads highway infrastructure transport dor.gov.np

items.name: Department of Water Supply and Sewerage Management
items.description: Responsible for planning and technical management of water supply and sewerage infrastructure and services.
items.descriptionNepali: खानेपानी तथा ढल व्यवस्थापनसम्बन्धी पूर्वाधार र सेवाको योजना तथा प्राविधिक व्यवस्थापन गर्ने विभाग।
items.keywords: water supply sewerage sanitation drinking water dwssm.gov.np

items.name: Department of Urban Development and Building Construction
items.nepali: शहरी विकास तथा भवन निर्माण विभाग
items.description: Responsible for urban development, public buildings, housing, and related physical infrastructure programs.
items.descriptionNepali: शहरी विकास, सरकारी भवन, आवास तथा सम्बन्धित भौतिक पूर्वाधार विकाससम्बन्धी कार्यक्रम सञ्चालन गर्ने विभाग।
items.keywords: urban development building housing infrastructure dudbc.gov.np

items.name: Department of Agriculture
items.description: Responsible for agricultural development, crop production, extension services, and agricultural technology promotion.
items.descriptionNepali: कृषि विकास, बाली उत्पादन, कृषि प्रसार सेवा तथा कृषि प्रविधिको प्रवर्द्धनसम्बन्धी कार्य गर्ने विभाग।
items.keywords: agriculture crop farming food rural doa.gov.np

items.name: Department of Livestock Services
items.description: Responsible for livestock development, animal health, veterinary services, and livestock production.
items.descriptionNepali: पशुपन्छी विकास, पशु स्वास्थ्य, पशु चिकित्सा सेवा तथा पशु उत्पादनसम्बन्धी कार्य गर्ने विभाग।
items.keywords: livestock animal health veterinary dls.gov.np

items.name: Department of Food Technology and Quality Control
items.nepali: खाद्य प्रविधि तथा गुण नियन्त्रण विभाग
items.description: Responsible for food safety, food technology, food testing, quality control, and regulation of food products.
items.descriptionNepali: खाद्य सुरक्षा, खाद्य प्रविधि, खाद्य परीक्षण, गुण नियन्त्रण तथा खाद्य पदार्थको नियमनसम्बन्धी कार्य गर्ने विभाग।
items.keywords: food safety technology quality control dftqc.gov.np

items.name: Department of Forests and Soil Conservation
items.description: Responsible for forest management, soil conservation, watershed protection, and related forestry programs.
items.descriptionNepali: वन व्यवस्थापन, भू-संरक्षण, जलाधार संरक्षण तथा सम्बन्धित वन व्यवस्थापन कार्यक्रम सञ्चालन गर्ने विभाग।
items.keywords: forest forestry soil conservation watershed dofsc.gov.np

items.name: Department of National Parks and Wildlife Conservation
items.nepali: राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्ज तथा वन्यजन्तु संरक्षण विभाग
items.description: Responsible for national parks, protected areas, wildlife conservation, and biodiversity protection.
items.descriptionNepali: राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्ज, संरक्षित क्षेत्र, वन्यजन्तु तथा जैविक विविधताको संरक्षणसम्बन्धी कार्य गर्ने विभाग।
items.keywords: national parks wildlife biodiversity conservation dnpwc.gov.np

items.name: Department of Hydrology and Meteorology
items.description: Provides hydrological and meteorological observations, forecasting, climate information, and related services.
items.descriptionNepali: जल तथा मौसमसम्बन्धी अवलोकन, पूर्वानुमान, जलवायु सूचना तथा सम्बन्धित सेवा उपलब्ध गराउने विभाग।
items.keywords: weather climate hydrology meteorology dhm.gov.np

items.name: Department of Health Services
items.description: Implements and coordinates public health programs and health service delivery across Nepal.
items.descriptionNepali: नेपालभर सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य कार्यक्रम तथा स्वास्थ्य सेवा प्रवाहसम्बन्धी कार्यक्रम कार्यान्वयन र समन्वय गर्ने विभाग।
items.keywords: health healthcare public health dohs.gov.np

items.name: Department of Drug Administration
items.description: Responsible for regulation, registration, quality, safety, and monitoring of medicines and pharmaceutical products.
items.descriptionNepali: औषधि तथा औषधिजन्य पदार्थको दर्ता, गुणस्तर, सुरक्षा, नियमन तथा अनुगमनसम्बन्धी कार्य गर्ने विभाग।
items.keywords: medicine drug pharmaceutical regulation dda.gov.np

items.name: Department of Survey
items.description: Responsible for cadastral surveying, mapping, geospatial surveying, and land measurement services.
items.descriptionNepali: नापी, कित्ताकाट, भू-सर्वेक्षण, नक्साङ्कन तथा भौगोलिक सूचना सम्बन्धी कार्य गर्ने विभाग।
items.keywords: survey cadastral mapping land geospatial dos.gov.np

items.name: Department of Land Management and Archive
items.description: Responsible for land administration, land records, registration, and management of land-related information.
items.descriptionNepali: भूमि प्रशासन, जग्गा अभिलेख, दर्ता तथा भूमि सम्बन्धी सूचनाको व्यवस्थापन गर्ने विभाग।

items.name: Department of Industry
items.description: Responsible for industrial registration, investment facilitation, industrial promotion, and regulation.
items.descriptionNepali: उद्योग दर्ता, औद्योगिक लगानी सहजीकरण, उद्योग प्रवर्द्धन तथा नियमनसम्बन्धी कार्य गर्ने विभाग।
items.keywords: industry investment industrial registration doind.gov.np

items.name: Department of Cottage and Small Industries
items.description: Supports registration, development, promotion, and regulation of cottage and small industries.
items.descriptionNepali: घरेलु तथा साना उद्योगको दर्ता, विकास, प्रवर्द्धन तथा नियमनसम्बन्धी कार्य गर्ने विभाग।
items.keywords: cottage small industries entrepreneurship dcsi.gov.np

items.name: Department of Commerce, Supplies and Consumer Protection
items.nepali: वाणिज्य, आपूर्ति तथा उपभोक्ता संरक्षण विभाग

items.descriptionNepali: वाणिज्य प्रशासन, बजार अनुगमन, आपूर्ति व्यवस्थापन तथा उपभोक्ता संरक्षणसम्बन्धी कार्य गर्ने विभाग।

items.name: Department of Mines and Geology
items.description: Responsible for geological surveys, mineral exploration, geological research, and mineral resource management.
items.descriptionNepali: भूगर्भीय सर्वेक्षण, खनिज अन्वेषण, भूगर्भीय अनुसन्धान तथा खनिज स्रोत व्यवस्थापनसम्बन्धी कार्य गर्ने विभाग।
items.keywords: mines geology minerals geological survey dmgnepal.gov.np

items.name: Department of Immigration
items.description: Responsible for immigration administration, visas, entry, stay, and departure of foreign nationals in Nepal.

items.keywords: immigration visa foreign nationals immigration.gov.np

items.name: Department of Prison Management
items.description: Responsible for administration and management of prisons and correctional facilities in Nepal.
items.descriptionNepali: नेपालका कारागार तथा सुधारगृहको प्रशासन र व्यवस्थापनसम्बन्धी कार्य गर्ने विभाग।
items.keywords: prison correctional facility prison management dopm.gov.np

items.name: Department of National ID and Civil Registration
items.description: Responsible for national identity management and civil registration services including vital event registration.
items.descriptionNepali: राष्ट्रिय परिचयपत्र तथा जन्म, मृत्यु, विवाह, बसाइँसराइ लगायतका व्यक्तिगत घटना दर्तासम्बन्धी सेवा व्यवस्थापन गर्ने विभाग।

items.name: Department of Information Technology
items.description: Responsible for development and implementation of information technology and digital government initiatives.
items.descriptionNepali: सूचना प्रविधिको विकास, प्रयोग तथा डिजिटल सरकारी सेवासम्बन्धी कार्यक्रम कार्यान्वयन गर्ने विभाग।
items.keywords: information technology digital government e-government doit.gov.np

items.name: Department of Archaeology
items.description: Responsible for archaeological research, conservation, protection, and management of cultural heritage.
items.descriptionNepali: पुरातात्त्विक अनुसन्धान, सांस्कृतिक सम्पदा संरक्षण, पुरातात्त्विक स्थल तथा स्मारकको व्यवस्थापनसम्बन्धी कार्य गर्ने विभाग।

items.name: Department of Printing
items.description: Provides official government printing and publication-related services.
items.descriptionNepali: सरकारी कागजात, प्रकाशन तथा आधिकारिक मुद्रणसम्बन्धी सेवा प्रदान गर्ने विभाग।
items.keywords: printing government publication documents dop.gov.np

items.name: Department of Postal Services
items.description: Responsible for postal administration and delivery of postal services throughout Nepal.
items.descriptionNepali: नेपालभर हुलाक प्रशासन तथा हुलाक सेवा सञ्चालन र व्यवस्थापन गर्ने विभाग।

items.keywords: fcgo treasury accounting public finance fcgo.gov.np

items.name: Department of Railways
items.description: Responsible for planning, development, expansion, and management of railway infrastructure and services in Nepal.
items.descriptionNepali: नेपालमा रेल्वे पूर्वाधार तथा सेवाको योजना, विकास, विस्तार र व्यवस्थापनसम्बन्धी कार्य गर्ने विभाग।
items.keywords: railways rail train transport dorw dorw.gov.np

items.description: Responsible for labour administration, labour inspection, occupational safety and health, and implementation of labour laws.
items.descriptionNepali: श्रम प्रशासन, श्रम निरीक्षण, व्यवसायजन्य सुरक्षा तथा स्वास्थ्य र श्रम कानून कार्यान्वयनसम्बन्धी कार्य गर्ने विभाग।
items.keywords: labour occupational safety osh inspection workers dolos dolos.gov.np

items.name: Department of Cooperatives

items.descriptionNepali: नेपालमा सहकारीको दर्ता, नियमन, प्रवर्द्धन तथा विकाससम्बन्धी कार्य गर्ने विभाग।
items.keywords: cooperatives co-op sahakari registration deoc deoc.gov.np

items.name: Department of Ayurveda and Alternative Medicine
items.description: Responsible for development, regulation, and service delivery of Ayurveda and other traditional and alternative medicine systems.

items.keywords: ayurveda alternative traditional medicine health doaa doaa.gov.np

items.name: Department of Information and Broadcasting

items.keywords: information broadcasting media press government doib doib.gov.np

items.name: Department of Passports

items.descriptionNepali: नेपाली पासपोर्ट जारीकरण, आवेदन प्रक्रिया, पूर्व-पंजीकरण र प्रमाणीकरण सेवाहरूको कार्य गर्ने विभाग।
items.keywords: passport rahadani passport issuance nepalpassport nepalpassport.gov.np
